Class GameConfig

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.GameConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameConfig extends Object implements Serializable
Holds game configuration values loaded from config.json.

Fields are populated via Jackson field-access deserialization.

  • buildingPerPlayer – matrix [playerCount-2][era] with the number of buildings to draw
  • startingFood – list of starting food per player position (1st through 5th)

  • Constructor Details

    • GameConfig

      public GameConfig()
      Default constructor for Jackson deserialization.

    • GameConfig

      protected GameConfig(int gameMaxPlayers, int gameMinPlayers, int[][] buildingPerPlayer, List<Integer> startingFood, int bottomExtraCards, int topExtraCards, int maxTurns, int artistGain)
      Protected constructor for testing purposes.
      Parameters:
      gameMaxPlayers - the maximum number of players allowed in the game
      gameMinPlayers - the minimum number of players allowed in the game
      buildingPerPlayer - the number of buildings to draw for each player and age
      startingFood - the amount of food each player starts with
      bottomExtraCards - the number of extra cards to draw from the bottom of the deck
      topExtraCards - the number of extra cards to draw from the top of the deck
      maxTurns - the maximum number of turns in the game
      artistGain - the number of points awarded for completing an artist's work
